summary.headline: Paulus and Rhetorius Chapters
summary.text: Catalog of astrological chapters in a Venetian codex, covering Paulus Alexandrinus’s introduction and Heliodorus’s exegesis on horoscoping degrees, spear-bearing, climacterics, maleficent stars, lunar nodes, and house-masters, followed by Rhetorius’s exposition of the zodiac and lots. Entries include folio references and a citation to Boll’s Florentine catalogue.
